messages.subject: if legend isn't excluded, it doesn't work
parts:
Hi,

This works when legend.position = "none," but not if the legend is left in. Any ideas why? And how I can get around it. Many thanks for this and all the help I've had in the past too.

Works:
ggplot(tst,aes(Product,value,colour=Metric))+
geom_bar(aes(weight=value,fill=Metric),alpha=.4,position="stack")+
facet_grid(~Year)+
labs(x="Credit Product",y="Source of Profit Volatility (% of product total)")+
opts(axis.ticks=theme_blank(),title="Year to Date",plot.title=theme_text(size=10)
,axis.title.x=theme_text(size=10),legend.position="none")+
coord_flip()+
scale_y_continuous(formatter="percent")

Does not work:
ggplot(tst,aes(Product,value,colour=Metric))+
geom_bar(aes(weight=value,fill=Metric),alpha=.4,position="stack")+
facet_grid(~Year)+
labs(x="Credit Product",y="Source of Profit Volatility (% of product total)")+

,axis.title.x=theme_text(size=10))+

Strange!

Now that you mentioned it, I have a data frame in my workspace named, "value." Apparently, the legend was trying to use it.

Now that I've deleted it, it's working. Thanks very much.

This was the error message I'd gotten, which indicates the legend was trying to use a separate data frame from my workspace, named, "value," which I'd apparently over-written during previous sessions with my own data?

Error in `[<-.data.frame`(`*tmp*`, var, value = list(weight = list(No.Cust = c(1197L,  :
  replacement element 1 is a matrix/data frame of 18 rows, need 3
